messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — Orion Health private deploy is blocked by customer network & image distribution constraints. Their infra team is refusing egress to Docker Hub and blocking our control-plane IPs. Need an architecture review + SI escalation. I opened ticket SI-4887.

Omar S: @Maya R can you paste the failing pod logs and confirm which deployment flavor (VPC/private on-prem)? :eyes:

Maya R: This is VPC private (customer-managed). Pod logs: ```Error: dial tcp 10.8.0.12:8443: i/o timeout
2026-03-21T15:02:11Z failed to fetch image "ghcr.io/redwood/private-agent:v2.1": context deadline exceeded``` They also block outbound to external registries (no docker hub / ghcr).

deploy-bot: Created ticket #SI-4887 and linked to partnerships pipeline. Assigned to Solomon (SI).

Solomon (SI): Saw the ticket. Two separate issues: 1) customer disallows egress to public registries, 2) their on-prem appliance requires a certified HSM driver (they only allow driver v470, our image expects v510). We can support airgapped install but need hardware partner sign-off for the HSM/driver compatibility and signed images for their compliance. Also, Marketplace listing requires signed SBOM & attestation.

Anil P: For the registry constraint we can switch image pulls to a customer S3 bucket (presigned URLs) or an internal registry hosted in their VPC. I'll draft a manifest and pull flow.\n

Katie L: Heads-up — we had a tentative joint announcement with Orion next month. This block could push the timeline. We should flag comms and pause the announcement until SI is green. @Maya R can you schedule an arch call?

Maya R: Scheduled a 30m arch review for 03/22 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maya, Omar, Anil, Solomon, Orion infra lead. I'll add partnerships after the call. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meetings/arch-orion (placeholder).

Omar S: Quick config snippet for presigned pulls: ```image: s3://orion-bucket/redwood/private-agent:v2.1
imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
registryAuth:
  type: presigned_url
  url: <presigned-url>``` We'll need to update our install controller to accept presigned pulls.

Solomon (SI): Also, the customer enforces narrow firewall rules. Please request an exception for TCP 4500-4510 for KV cache replication between pods (we use that for prefix/KV sync). Without it, caching/multi-region failover will break. Add that to the agenda.

Maya R: Added to the agenda. Next steps captured in ticket SI-4887: Anil to produce presigned image flow doc + manifest, Solomon to confirm HSM driver path with NVIDIAEdge hardware partner, Omar to prepare a fallback policy (hosted model routing) if private deploy can't be completed in time. Katie to update comms plan and hold the joint announcement until green.

Anil P: I'll have the presigned flow doc and example manifest by EOD today. :thumbsup:

Katie L: I'll pause the announcement and update the partners channel with a short note after the call.

Omar S: FYI, fallback policy should include model routing config: prefer private endpoint -> if healthcheck fails for >3 attempts route to hosted: 
```routing:
  primary: private-orion-redwood
  fallback: hosted-small
  healthcheck_interval: 15s
  failure_threshold: 3
```

Solomon (SI): I'll reach out to NVIDIAEdge for driver compat and signed image attestation. Expect an update by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Arch review scheduled for 1781318400 (2026-03-22 10:00 PT).

Maya R: Thanks all — will post the call notes and update SI-4887. Please add any pre-read items to the ticket thread.
